no-gmail-authors/check/1.body:
range="${CI_CONTRACT_BASE}..${CI_CONTRACT_HEAD}"
bad=$(git log --format='%ae %ce' "$range" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -iE 'gmail\.com' | sort -u || true)
if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
  echo "::error::Commit(s) in this PR use a personal gmail author/committer address:"
  echo "$bad"
  echo "Commit as the nolanmak GitHub noreply instead — see docs/PUBLISH.md."
  exit 1
fi
echo "OK: no gmail author/committer emails in this PR's commits."
